'''Mariah''' (Japanese: '''ミサト''' ''Misato'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG086|Lights, Camerupt, Action!]]''.

Mariah lives in a small town in [[Hoenn]] that doesn't have a movie theater. As a result, she developed a friendship with [[Elijah]], who uses his {{p|Camerupt}} to bring movies to small towns and have viewings for them. The first time Elijah came to her town, she was so impressed with him that she wrote a letter to him, asking for him to return with a new film.

While she anxiously waited, Elijah and his Camerupt were aided by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. They fought off {{TRT}} and helped get the film to Mariah and all of her friends. Once again, she was very happy and impressed with her friend for making such an incredible journey.
